subject.title: improve(ui): move Devices into Settings and redesign the device inventory

question: Should Devices become Settings-only even though existing persisted `nodes` sidebar pins are discarded during normalization?
rationale: The change intentionally alters a user navigation preference, and the protected maintainer label indicates this product/compatibility choice needs explicit human ownership.

options.title: Move and migrate
options.body: Place Devices under Settings while translating existing pinned `nodes` entries to a supported Settings shortcut or equivalent discoverable destination.

options.title: Move and drop pins
options.body: Accept removal of persisted Devices pins as an intentional navigation reset and document the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep top-level access
options.body: Retain a top-level Devices entry while landing only the inventory redesign.

recommendation.title: Move and migrate
recommendation.body: Place Devices under Settings while translating existing pinned `nodes` entries to a supported Settings shortcut or equivalent discoverable destination.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows steipete authored the navigation and inventory redesign, but current-main ownership could not be independently verified.
